# dim_itineraries

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.dim_itineraries` · dbt area: `portal`

Dimension table for itineraries, which are collections of blocks of content that advisors create to represent a trip, a proposal, or use for marketing. Each row represents a single itinerary. Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `itinerary_id` | Primary Key. Unique ID assigned to each itinerary. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `advisor_id` | Foreign Key. Unique ID assigned to each Advisor. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `archived_at` | When the Itinerary was archived by an Advisor. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `certification_when_itinerary_first_published` | The estimated certification level of the advisor when the Itinerary was first published. This uses an approximate date of certification based on history table in Eastern Time ('America/New_York'), which may cause the dates to be off by 1-2 days. Null for unpublished itineraries. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `created_at` | When an Advisor creates the Itinerary (clicks Create Itinerary in Portal). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `days_itinerary_created_to_first_published` | Calendar days from Itinerary created to its first published date. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `days_itinerary_created_to_last_published` | Calendar days from Itinerary created to its last (most recent) published date.  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `days_trip_created_to_itinerary_created` | Calendar days from Trip created to Itinerary created. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `days_trip_created_to_itinerary_first_published` | Calendar days from Trip created to the Itinerary's first published date. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `days_trip_created_to_itinerary_last_published` | Calendar days from  Trip created to the Itinerary's last published date. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `first_published_at` | When the Itinerary was first published. In cases where an Itinerary has only been published once, this will be the same as the last published date. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_ai_appended_itinerary` | True/False flag of whether an Itinerary had pages appended via the AI ingest feature. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_ai_ingest_itinerary` | True/False flag of whether an Itinerary was initially generated via the AI ingest feature. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_archived` | True/False flag of whether an Itinerary has been deleted. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_duplicated` | True/False flag of whether an Itinerary has been duplicated. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_proposal` | True/False flag of whether the Itinerary is a proposal. A proposal is when an itinerary was first published before or without a booking attached to the trip  >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_published` | True/False flag of whether the Itinerary is published. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_republished` | True/False flag of whether an Itinerary has been published more than once. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_from_via` | True/False flag of whether the Itinerary was created by the Via AI agent. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_created_or_appended_from_template` | True/False flag of whether the Itinerary was created or appended from a template. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `itinerary_status` | A calculated field representing the status of an Itinerary - published, unpublished, or archived. An itinerary is considered 'published' if it has a published version, 'unpublished' if it does not, and 'archived' if any version is marked as archived. SOURCE >> Portal |
| `last_published_at` | When the Itinerary was most recently published. If an Itinerary has only ever been published once, this equals first_published_at; otherwise it updates on every re-publish. >> SOURCE – Portal |
| `latest_itinerary_version_id` | Foreign Key. The itinerary_version_id of the most recent version of the itinerary. A new version_id is generated each time an itinerary is republished. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `publication_count` | The number of times an Itinerary was published (including initial publish + any republish). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `trip_id` | Foreign Key. Unique ID for each Trip record. >>  SOURCE - Portal |
